I'm having a shitty time. Started off on StrongLifts 5x5, ran it for a year, maybe a year and a half and got great results, but I hit a progress wall around 270lb squat, 355lb deadlift, 150lb bench.

I realized my routine was too focused and leaving out important muscles, so I switched over to FitBod, which has much broader ideas about my workouts. On 5x5, I would do 1x5 deadlifts, for example. FitBod will go anywhere from 3x4 to 5x8 deadlifts, depending on what routine it's put together that day.

As a result, my endurance is going up--I think--but my pet-lift weight values are down and I an't compare one workout to another so easily. Some days I go in and fail 2/3 of my workout, to some degree or another, but I guess I sorta-kinda feel like I'm hitting my stride.
